connectors.name: Gmail (app password)
connectors.notes: Email over IMAP and SMTP with an app password. Reads run in tools; every change is a planned action the person reviews first.

mail.app_password_help: Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google account, then create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and paste the 16 letters here. If Google says “The setting you are looking for is not available for your account”: check you are signed in to the right Google account (top right), that 2-Step Verification includes a phone prompt, authenticator app or backup codes (not only passkeys or security keys), and that it is not a work, school or Advanced Protection account.

connectors.name: Gmail

auth.client_setup: In Google Cloud, enable the Gmail API, create an OAuth client for a desktop app, and paste its client ID and secret here (or import the downloaded file).

connectors.notes: 2026-10-30: Gmail through the regular Gmail REST API (gmail.googleapis.com) with the gmail.modify scope (read, drafts, send, labels, trash; no permanent delete), so personal Google accounts work. Reads run in tools; every change is a planned action the person reviews first. Google's Gmail MCP server (gmailmcp.googleapis.com) is a Workspace Developer Preview; add it as a custom connection if you have access. Sign-in uses Google OIDC discovery from the catalog authorization server; no DCR; resource indicator disabled.

connectors.name: Google Calendar

auth.client_setup: Google Calendar's MCP server is in Google's Developer Preview. In Google Cloud, enable the Calendar API and Calendar MCP API, create an OAuth client for a desktop app, and paste its client ID and secret here.

connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize accepts unauthenticated requests; PRM assumed absent as for Gmail. Google OIDC discovery supplies authorize https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth, token https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token and revoke https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke; no DCR. UNVERIFIED: resource indicator disabled because Google OAuth is not documented to accept RFC 8707 resource; authenticated OAuth/loopback flow has not been verified. Supplementary live discovery 2026-10-27: path-suffixed PRM at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp/v1 responds with the MCP URL as resource and AS https://accounts.google.com/ (root-slash equivalent to the metadata issuer); the origin PRM remains absent. Google also serves RFC 8414 metadata.

connectors.name: Slack

auth.client_setup: Create a Slack app with user scopes, add the redirect URL shown here, and paste its client ID and secret.

connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize returns 401 with origin PRM; resource and authorization server are https://mcp.slack.com. Authorize endpoint is https://slack.com/oauth/v2_user/authorize; no DCR. Fixed callback http://127.0.0.1:53682/callback supports preregistered providers requiring an exact redirect URL; fail if this port is busy.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize returns 401 with path-suffixed PRM and scope hint default; resource is https://mcp.notion.com/mcp; DCR available.

connectors.name: GitHub

auth.client_setup: Create a GitHub OAuth app with the redirect URL shown here, and paste its client ID and secret.

connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize returns 401 with path-suffixed /mcp/ PRM; resource is https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ and authorization server is https://github.com/login/oauth (OIDC-style metadata); no DCR. Fixed callback http://127.0.0.1:53682/callback supports preregistered providers requiring an exact redirect URL; fail if this port is busy.

connectors.name: Linear
connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize returns 401 with path-suffixed PRM and scope hint read write; resource is the origin https://mcp.linear.app; DCR available.

connectors.name: Jira (Atlassian)
connectors.notes: 2026-10-27: Initialize returns 401 without resource_metadata; origin and path-suffixed PRM return 404. Origin RFC 8414 discovery supplies /v1/authorize, /v1/token and /v1/register; DCR available.
